name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Orders and kitchen of a food truck
promotionalText: Take pre-orders, protect your kitchen from way too many orders, and service carries on even if the signal is lost. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team uses in every service.

Customers order early and they choose a pick-up time. Your staff see every order on a single screen, confirm what the kitchen can cook, and then mark the order “Ready” and “Picked up”.

DON’T PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN’T MANAGE
Set how much your kitchen can cook at the same time and how long it takes. When a pick-up time is full, customers can no longer choose it, so the queue matches the kitchen’s speed.

TAKE ORDERS RIGHT AT THE TRUCK
Add walk-in orders on the same screen as pre-orders, so the kitchen follows just one queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen display (KDS) shows what to cook now, what’s next and what’s ready, with an alert when an order needs to be started.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect the kitchen’s receipt printer using Bluetooth or your local network, and order tickets print automatically.

SERVICE CARRIES ON EVEN IF THE SIGNAL IS LOST
Turn on offline protection, and when the connection is lost, pre-orders are paused for now so nobody can place an order you won’t see. Orders you took on the device are saved and sync when you are back online.

MADE FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, get a notification when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Set up your events and locations once, and take orders for each one.

HatchGrab is for food truck operators and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to log in.
whatsNew:
